groups.comparison: 767 runtime fitted socket intersects selected original body face membership, canonical UV triangle barycentrics, anatomical skin threshold and outward alignment with deterministic face tie. It samples shell positions/normals by preserved original body indices BEFORE compaction. Bootstrap is authoring-only old-ray conversion, verifies shell face maps to body face and UV corners; not a runtime fallback path. Public independently paired same-count layouts/mesh/shell can violate identity preconditions, normal caller765 passes same canonical source; no new actual bad caller.

777 image adds image and matching texture index together; Standalone embeds exact bytes in binary views, SharedTextures derives filename from entire bytes and refuses existing differing content. BTreeMap deduplicates file bytes, image role entries may repeat intentionally. Pointer cache only current immutable ShellTextures borrow within single export, not long-lived mutable cache. Base-color/normal/occlusion and normal/metal-roughness roles kept distinct; base-color map overrides factor, normal-only preserves authored factor. Packaging does not independently decode arbitrary user PNG bytes.

770 four-byte pads JSON/binary, aligns all767 BufferBuilder views, writes declared total/chunk lengths and payloads together. Native u32 header narrowing has capacity precondition; no feasible huge-file or actual serialization failure witness. Shared textures written before final GLB; no transactional rollback claimed for arbitrary filesystem failure. Inspection only.
